moments.title: New Reform UK Leader for Wales
moments.blurb: Helen Jenner has been announced as the new leader of Reform UK in Wales, following the resignation of Dan Thomas.

angles.name: Breaking News
angles.copy: BREAKING: Helen Jenner is the new leader of Reform UK in Wales! Nigel Farage made the announcement today in Cardiff. Big changes for Welsh politics. #WelshPolitics

angles.name: Political Impact
angles.copy: Reform UK has a new face leading its charge in Wales as Helen Jenner steps up. What does this mean for the political landscape across the UK?

moments.title: Welsh Gov Business Rate Cut
moments.blurb: The Welsh Government has announced a 30% cut in business rates for small hospitality and leisure venues, including theatres, cinemas, clubs, and music venues, effective from April 1, 2027.

angles.name: Local Boost
angles.copy: Fantastic news for Welsh businesses! The Welsh Government is cutting business rates by 30% for hospitality and leisure venues. A huge boost for our local pubs, theatres, and music spots!

angles.name: Culture Sector Win
angles.copy: A significant move from the Welsh Government, cutting business rates for cultural and leisure venues. Could this be a blueprint for supporting arts and entertainment across the UK?

moments.title: Exeter Uni Publishing Research
moments.blurb: A new research project launched today at the University of Exeter will investigate how China's innovative online literature publishing models could benefit the UK publishing sector.

angles.name: Local Innovation
angles.copy: Big brains at the University of Exeter are leading a new study today into the future of publishing! Could China's online literature models revolutionise how we read and write in the UK?

angles.name: Future of Books
angles.copy: Is the future of publishing online? Researchers at Exeter are looking at innovative models from China to see how they could transform the UK's literary world.

moments.title: Equinox Festival Closes
moments.blurb: The Equinox Festival 2026, a grassroots music and arts festival in Lincolnshire, wraps up today after four days of live bands, DJs, workshops, and family-friendly vibes.

angles.name: Festival Wrap
angles.copy: That's a wrap on Equinox Festival 2026! Who was there soaking up the last of the summer festival vibes in Lincolnshire? Tell us your highlights!

angles.name: Post-Festival Blues
angles.copy: The tents are coming down at Equinox Festival. If you're feeling those post-festival blues, we've got the tunes to keep the party going!

moments.title: Rye Arts Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The multi-venue Rye Arts Festival in East Sussex continues until September 27, offering a diverse programme of music, literature, theatre, film, and visual arts.

angles.name: Arts in Sussex
angles.copy: Still time to catch the best of the Rye Arts Festival! Running until September 27, it's a celebration of music, literature, and more in East Sussex. What's on your list to see?

moments.title: Niall Horan UK Tour Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Niall Horan's 'Dinner Party' UK tour begins tomorrow, September 22, in Birmingham, bringing his latest album and hits across the country until October 2.

angles.name: Niall's Back!
angles.copy: Get ready, Directioners! Niall Horan's 'Dinner Party' UK tour kicks off tomorrow in Birmingham! Who's got tickets to see him live?

angles.name: Tour Buzz
angles.copy: Niall Horan is hitting the road across the UK starting tomorrow! Expect a mix of new tracks and classic hits from his 'Dinner Party' album and beyond.

moments.title: Pussycat Dolls Reunion Tour
moments.blurb: The Pussycat Dolls' 'PCD Forever Tour' celebrates 20 years since 'Don't Cha' and their debut album, starting its UK leg on September 29 in Birmingham.

angles.name: Don't Cha Wish...
angles.copy: The Pussycat Dolls are back! Their 'PCD Forever Tour' kicks off its UK dates on September 29. Get ready to sing along to all their hits!

angles.name: 20 Years of Hits
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 20 years since 'Don't Cha'? The Pussycat Dolls are celebrating with a massive reunion tour hitting the UK next week!

moments.title: AVA Festival London
moments.blurb: AVA Festival London, focusing on electronic music and arts, takes place from September 24-26, bringing a vibrant lineup to the capital.

angles.name: London Dance
angles.copy: Get ready, London! AVA Festival is bringing the best in electronic music and visual arts to the capital from Sept 24-26. Who's heading to Crystal Palace Park?

moments.title: Float Along Festival Sheffield
moments.blurb: Sheffield hosts the Float Along Festival on September 26, a one-day music event for indie and alternative fans.

angles.name: Sheffield Sounds
angles.copy: Sheffield's Float Along Festival is happening this Saturday, September 26! Who's ready for a day of incredible indie and alternative acts?

moments.title: Homobloc Manchester

angles.name: Manchester Dance

moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' rules the Official UK Singles Chart this week. Are you streaming it on repeat?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: The UK Singles Chart is in! Sienna Spiro holds strong at number one, while Miley Cyrus makes a new entry with 'Bass Persuades'. What's your favourite from the Top 40?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher's 54th Birthday

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

angles.name: Iconic Frontman
angles.copy: The voice of a generation turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very Happy Birthday. We're blasting Oasis all day long!

angles.name: Country Queen

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Get ready to wish 'The Boss' a very Happy 77th Birthday on Wednesday! What's your all-time favourite Bruce Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Bruce Springsteen turns 77 this Wednesday! We're celebrating the enduring legacy of one of rock's most electrifying performers.

moments.title: Donald Glover's 43rd Birthday

angles.name: Childish Gambino

moments.title: Hilary Duff's 39th Birthday
moments.blurb: Actress and singer Hilary Duff, known for 'Lizzie McGuire' and her pop hits, celebrates her 39th birthday on September 28.

angles.name: Lizzie McGuire Star

angles.name: Voice of Romance
angles.copy: A true legend turns 91 this Wednesday! Happy Birthday to the iconic Johnny Mathis. We're playing his timeless love songs all day.

moments.title: Autumn Begins Tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, falls tomorrow, September 22.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Say goodbye to summer! The Autumn Equinox is tomorrow, September 22, officially ushering in crisper air, changing leaves, and pumpkin spice everything. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: The season is changing! Tomorrow marks the official start of autumn. Time for cosy nights in and scenic walks.

angles.name: Pumpkin Fun

moments.title: York Food & Drink Festival

angles.name: Foodie Heaven
angles.copy: Calling all foodies! The York Food and Drink Festival is in full swing until September 27, showcasing the best local produce. What are you trying first?

moments.title: Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26

angles.name: Baking Bonanza
angles.copy: Got a sweet tooth? Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26 is happening this weekend, Sept 26-27! Get ready for two days of delicious baking, treats, and demos.

moments.title: Sense and Sensibility Film Release

angles.name: Devon on Screen
angles.copy: Exciting news for Devon! A new 'Sense and Sensibility' film, partly shot in Dartmoor and Devon, is out this Saturday, Sept 26. Will you be watching?

angles.name: Literary Adaptation
angles.copy: Jane Austen fans, rejoice! A new adaptation of 'Sense and Sensibility' hits screens this Saturday, featuring stunning UK scenery.

moments.title: Aberfan Disaster 60th Anniversary
moments.blurb: The Welsh First Minister will lead a moment of reflection on October 21st to mark the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan tragedy, which claimed 144 lives in 1966.

angles.name: Remembering Aberfan
angles.copy: Wales will mark the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster on October 21st with a moment of reflection. We remember the 144 lives lost in 1966.

angles.name: National Reflection
angles.copy: The Welsh First Minister has called for a minute's silence on October 21st to commemorate the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan tragedy. A time for national remembrance.
